data.key: Knight Of The Sepulcher ~ Will Of The Crypt
data.name: Will of the Crypt
data.description: At 11th level, a knight of the sepulcher's bonus on saving throws against mind affecting effects and death effects increases to +4. This ability replaces the aura of vengeance ability.
